name: East International, runway 18/36
summary: The north-south runway of the test field's crossing airliner airport, laid as Cape International's 18/36 is. Landed on northward (36); both ends take a 10 NM final.

sources.length_m: As Cape International's: the 747-400 at its maximum weight on a hot day, Boeing D6-58326-1 rev F 3.3.4, rounded up to 3,500 m.
sources.width_m: FAA AC 150/5300-13B change 1, table G-11 (C/D/E-V): 150 ft.
sources.protection: The same table as Cape International's, approach visibility below 3/4 mile; the test field's ground also keeps a 34:1 funnel clear 10 NM off each end (Airfield.pads_for).
sources.place: The test field's east side, x +17 km; runway 09/27 lies where Cape International's does relative to it (700 m west, 1,100 m north), so the crossing is 2,450 m from 09's threshold and 2,850 m from 36's, as at the cape.
